id.description: Unique identifier of the Form Template. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete a specific Form Template.

name.description: Human-readable name of the Form Template, shown to users when selecting a template to fill out.

description.description: Longer description explaining the purpose of the Form Template or instructions for completing it.

assign_to_new_projects.description: If true, the Form Template is assigned to each Project created in the Company from this point forward, unless that Project is created from a Project Template. Existing Projects are not affected

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Form Template was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Form Template was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

archived_at.description: Timestamp when the Form Template was archived, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the template is active (not archived).

created_by.description: User who created the Form Template.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the Form Template.

login.description: Email/login of the user who created the Form Template.

name.description: Full name of the user who created the Form Template.

attachment.description: Reference to the uploaded PDF file associated with this Form Template. Null when no file has been attached.

id.description: Unique identifier of the attached file.

url.description: Download URL for the attached file.

filename.description: Original filename of the attached file.

name.description: Display name of the attached file.

fillable_pdf.description: Reference to the fillable PDF that project users complete when filling out a form from this template. Null when no fillable PDF has been uploaded.

id.description: Unique identifier of the fillable PDF file.

url.description: Download URL for the fillable PDF file.

filename.description: Original filename of the fillable PDF file.

name.description: Display name of the fillable PDF file.

403.description: User does not have permission to update the Form Template

name.description: The Name of the Form Template

description.description: The Description of the Form Template

assign_to_new_projects.description: If true, the Form Template is assigned to each Project created in the Company from this point forward, unless that Project is created from a Project Template. Existing Projects are not affected.

fillable_pdf.description:
Form's Fillable PDF.
To upload a fillable PDF you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `fillable_pdf` as files.
